name: loophub
description: GitHub-style issue/PR hub over local git repositories, built for AI agents to run development loops while a human supervises.
author: Kazuyuki Kohno

scripts.postinstall: bun run setup-hooks && bun install --cwd web --frozen-lockfile
scripts.serve: concurrently --kill-others --names web,git,github,agents,dispatcher,queue "npm run lh-web" "npm run lh-watcher-git" "npm run lh-watcher-github" "npm run lh-watcher-agents" "npm run lh-dispatcher" "npm run lh-job-queue"
scripts.serve:debug: concurrently --kill-others --names web,git,github,agents,dispatcher,queue "npm run lh-web -- --debug" "npm run lh-watcher-git" "npm run lh-watcher-github" "npm run lh-watcher-agents" "npm run lh-dispatcher" "npm run lh-job-queue"
scripts.test: bun scripts/test.ts fast && bun run test:web
scripts.test:full: bun scripts/test.ts full && bun run test:web
